Bookkeeping & admin - AI tools for contractors

Categorising expenses, capturing receipts and keeping the accounts current.

Why this matters A shoebox of receipts in April costs more in accountant fees than the software would have.

What Bookkeeping & admin actually involves

Bookkeeping is the admin everyone postpones, and the cost appears once a year as accountant fees. Photographing receipts the day you spend the money and connecting a bank feed is most of the work; the rest is categorising consistently so the numbers mean something at year end.

Frequently asked questions

Which bookkeeping & admin tools are worth trying first?

The three that stand out here are QuickBooks (Businesses that need proper books and an accountant who already knows the software), FreshBooks (Owner-operators who want invoicing without an accounting degree), Xero (Businesses wanting cloud accounting with trade-specific add-ons). Start with the one that matches your size and the work you do most, not the one with the longest feature list.

How much does bookkeeping & admin software cost?

Across the 5 tools on this page, 1 have a free tier and the rest are paid, most of them billed per user per month. Prices move often, so confirm on the vendor site before committing.

Can I try these tools for free?

Yes 鈥?Expensify all have a free tier, so you can run a few real jobs through them before paying anything.

Can I do my own bookkeeping as a small trade business?

Yes for day-to-day recording, and most owners do. What is worth paying for is year-end and tax advice. Software handles the recording; a good accountant stops you making expensive structural mistakes.
